Risk Description: Employee pastes customer PII/PHI into public ChatGPT or Claude
Mitigation: AI Acceptable Use Policy + DLP + CASB block + mandatory training

Risk Description: Prompt injection via uploaded PDF causes LLM to reveal system prompt or confidential data
Mitigation: Input sanitization + disable file parsing + LLM firewall + adversarial training

Risk Description: Third-party LLM vendor trains foundation model on customer data
Mitigation: Zero data retention contract + BAA + vendor audit

Risk Description: Model hallucination provides incorrect legal/medical/financial advice to customer
Mitigation: Human-in-the-loop review + output disclaimers + use case restrictions

Risk Description: Shadow AI: business units procure unapproved AI SaaS without security review
Mitigation: SaaS discovery tools + procurement policy gate + security training

Risk Description: Model bias in hiring/finance LLM causes discriminatory outcomes
Mitigation: Algorithmic Impact Assessment + bias testing + human oversight

Risk Description: Training data poisoning via public data scrape injects backdoor
Mitigation: Data provenance checks + model validation + red teaming

Risk Description: Model theft via API extraction or model inversion attacks
